title: Canonical etale exceptional duality and its unit over arbitrary bases
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, let $e:V\to W$ be a separated etale morphism of arbitrary schemes [def-weil-etale-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism], and suppose $e$ admits an open-then-proper factorization as in [lem-sf-etale-ambient-adjoint-projection]. Use the ordinary unbounded etale categories, the compact-support adjunction $F_e\dashv G_e$, its counit, $\omega_e=G_eA_W$ and the canonical $\theta_e$ defined in [lem-sf-etale-ambient-adjoint-projection]. There is a counit-preserving identification $\rho_e:G_e\xrightarrow{\sim}e^*$ obtained from exact etale sum extension [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension] and its evaluation adjunction. Writing $\eta_e=\rho_{e,A_W}:\omega_e\xrightarrow{\sim}A_V$ with the pullback unit identification inserted, one has, for every $K\in D(W_{\mathrm{et}},A)$,
$$\rho_{e,K}\circ\theta_{e,K}=\lambda_{e^*K}\circ(\eta_e\otimes1).$$
In particular $\omega_e\cong A_V$ and every $\theta_{e,K}$ is an isomorphism. This includes open immersions without a quasi-compactness assumption.

proof.text: Use the existing exact etale sum/evaluation adjunction. The graph comparison a is invertible, so its conjugate rho is invertible. The Mathlib conjugateEquiv_counit formula gives exactly the required counit equation. Its unit component followed by the specified pullback-unit isomorphism is eta and is invertible.

Transport the canonical natural tensor isomorphism from left-derived pullback to exact termwise pullback. Naturality of its comparison isomorphism transports the proved upstream left-unit law to the exact-model tensor comparison. The generic transport calculation is proved privately in this module; no arbitrary monoidal system is selected.

Unfold the specified ambient theta as the adjunct of inverse projection followed by the compact-support counit and the left unitor, transporting its domain along L(e*) = D(e*). The elementary conjugate/Hom-equivalence formula changes rho theta into the exact-sum adjunct after a. Apply the graph/projection square at omega and K. Naturality in the first tensor variable combines a_omega with the counit.

For an adjunction S adjoint E, the adjunct of projection followed by tensor(f,1) is tensor(adjunct(f),1) followed by the inverse exact tensor comparison. This follows directly from projectionMap_app_app, Hom-equivalence naturality, and naturality of the tensor comparison. For f = a_omega followed by the compact-support counit, its adjunct is rho at the coefficient unit, by the right triangle. The transported left-unit law now identifies the expression with tensor(eta,1) followed by the left unitor, proving the normalization equation.

The normalization identity expresses exact theta followed by invertible rho as tensoring the invertible eta followed by a unitor. Cancel rho, then cancel the invertible exact/left-derived domain transport. This proves invertibility of the original ambient theta without any quasi-compactness or boundedness assumption.

lean.note: The canonical rho is the adjunction mate of upstream compactificationEtaleComparison under the exact sum/evaluation adjunction. The theorem asserts its invertibility and explicit counit equation, the normalized tensor-map identity, invertibility of the specified eta, and invertibility of the original ambient theta. The exact-model theta helper transports the domain of sfEtaleAmbientTensorMap along leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory. Arbitrary schemes and arbitrary open immersions are retained; no quasi-compactness, Noetherian or boundedness assumptions. G and adj select any right adjoint supplied by the ambient theorem; no additional geometric existence hypothesis.
